title: REQ · Poll aborts on Git failures and keeps going after a Close failure
summary: Pull and list errors abort Poll; Close errors are joined and do not stop other Rounds
description: Context: the worker polls repeatedly and must survive partial failures. Desired behavior: a Pull error returns Result{} and an error wrapping the cause with prefix 'poller: pull'; a ListRounds error returns 'poller: list rounds'; a Close failure is collected with errors.Join as 'poller: close <id>' while remaining Rounds are processed and the failed ID is excluded from Closed. A nil Closer with an expired Round yields an error instead of a panic.
acceptance_criteria: Given Pull returns an error, when Poll runs, then the error satisfies errors.Is against it and ListRounds and Close are not called.
Given ListRounds returns an error, then Poll returns it wrapped and Close is not called.
Given two expired Rounds where the first Close fails, then the second is still closed, the returned error wraps the first failure and Result.Closed lacks the first ID.
Given a nil Closer and an expired Round, then Poll returns an error and does not panic.
